_about: Ground-truth labels for the evaluation set: 48 of the 64 acceptance criteria, labelled by reading each criterion's linked diffs in full. pass = the linked code clearly satisfies the whole criterion; fail = it clearly doesn't (or there is no linked code); unclear = the diffs can't settle it (runtime or performance claims, partial evidence). WHO LABELLED THEM: Labels are AI-generated with a two-pass independent agreement check. Ed specified the process; a third independent AI pass adjudicated the disagreements, which are listed for human review. Claude Code (AI) wrote these 48 labels. On a 20-criterion sample (seed 7, the items in relabel.html), two fresh, independent AI passes agreed on 17 of 20 (85%, Cohen's kappa 0.72), and the adjudicated labels agreed with these on 18 of 20 (90%, kappa 0.82); see seed/relabel_two_pass.json. Every labeller so far is a Claude model, the same family as the judge, so this measures stability, not correctness.
labeled_by: Claude Code (AI); two-pass independent agreement check on a 20-item sample; disagreements adjudicated by a third AI pass, pending human review
